description: This file contains utility functions for dumping and visualizing intermediate representation (IR) nodes in the Torch lazy computation graph, including generating DOT and text formats, and handling node attributes and relationships.

methods.name: ToDot
methods.description: Converts a list of nodes to a DOT graph representation.

methods.name: PostOrderToDot
methods.description: Generates DOT graph string from post-order nodes and roots.

methods.name: ToText
methods.description: Converts a list of nodes to a human-readable IR text format.

methods.name: PostOrderToText
methods.description: Generates IR text string from post-order nodes and roots.

methods.name: ToBackend
methods.description: Converts IR values to backend-specific text representation.
